<!-- pr-reviewer: cd3669c58d4c5122d122ea3a1afbe16f610f92c2 -->
**Verdict: the code of this PR is clean. The head is not `merge-ready`, because one suite is red on this head. The red suite is also red on `upstream/main` (#3774), not because of this PR.**

Review of head `cd3669c58`, trial-merged with `upstream/main` `79d47c282`. Built and tested locally (macOS). Tier: safety. The PR changes the plasma clause of the post verification gate (problem or warning), so I ran mutations on it.

### What looks good

- `warning_kind` returns `None` for each refusal (`CutOrder`, `CutCrossing`, `Malformed`). The match also keeps the `!f.refuses()` guard. A finding goes to `problems` unless both checks say "warning". The set of refusals does not change, and a new law that is not named falls to `problems` (fail-safe).
- `ok` and `held_by` do not change. The tip-up and kerf-crossing laws warn, as `PlasmaFinding::refuses` says.
- MCP `verify` findings use the op label, `move: null` and `blocks_post: false`, the same shape as the other findings.
- The `not_judged` line does not change. The decision record gives the reason (the G-code viewer header reads only that line).
- The pin asserts the finding, the op warning, no gate problem, an empty `held_by` and `ok: true`.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in non-test code. The new test is in an existing suite file (`mcp_plasma.rs`), not a new binary.
- The body has `Fixes #3456`, a `Changelog:` line and a "Goldens moved: none" section. The commit subject is conventional. The PR changes no UI, so no screenshots are necessary.

### Results (local, trial merge `79573ad20`)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` | ok |
| Pinning test `plasma_mcp_verify_lists_a_tip_up_as_a_finding_and_an_operation_warning` | ok |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (307 steps) | 306 ok, **1 failed**: `app suites: rotary_verify` |
| `app suites: example_catalog` (39 passed, 4 ignored), `example_catalog_edge_work` | ok (in the quick gate) |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` (6 steps) | ok, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The red step:

```
test a_rough_over_an_oversized_bar_peels_from_the_stock_radius ... FAILED
panicked at crates/app/tests/rotary_verify.rs:348:5:
assertion `left == right` failed: the matching bar has no air level - its ladder must not move
  left: 2110
 right: 2064
```

I ran the same suite on bare `upstream/main` `79d47c282` (without this PR). It fails with the same values (`2110` / `2064`). Issue #3774 ("main is red (post-merge gate)", `P2`) records it. This PR does not touch rotary or motion code.

**Extra suites run:** `mcp_plasma`, `plasma_gate`, `mcp_verify`, `plasma_post_refusals`, `plasma_post`, `plasma_profile`, `post_serves_plasma`, `coarse_probe_plasma`, `plasma_cut_data`, `plasma_machine`: all ok. The diff changes no `testdata/` file and no importer code, so the test-data and importer suites are not necessary.

**Heavy lanes:** not run - owed. The heavy reach is 62 `app heavy:` steps. The diff reaches them only through the crate dependency (it changes `camcraft-app`). No heavy record names this head. This is a `P3` PR.

**Goldens moved:** none. The diff changes no `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file. This agrees with the body.

### Mutations (each on the trial merge, then restored)

1. `posting_plasma.rs`: let a refusal pass as a warning (`CutOrder` gets a warning kind, and the `!f.refuses()` guard is removed). Result: red. `plasma_mcp_reports_bad_cut_order_and_refuses_to_write_nc` fails at `mcp_plasma.rs:212`. The refusal stays pinned.
2. `mcp/job.rs`: remove the `findings.push` of the gate warnings. Result: red. The pin fails at `mcp_plasma.rs:275` (no finding).

### Requested before merge

None in the code of this PR. The label `merge-ready` waits for a head on which all steps are green. When #3774 is fixed on `main`, merge `main` into the branch, run `rotary_verify` again and run the owed heavy lanes. Then a review of that head can set the label.

### Notes (not blocking)

- `crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs:357`: `verify` with a `name` lists the gate warnings of all plasma operations, also of operations out of scope. The gate problems are also for the whole program, so this agrees with the current shape. A filter by scope can be a `P7` follow-up if a client needs it.
- The issue asks that `not_judged` "only says what was not judged". The PR keeps the warnings in that line, and the decision record gives the reason (the UI reads only that line). That choice is recorded and is acceptable.
- `crates/app/src/posting.rs` (1664 lines) and `crates/app/src/script/api.rs` (544 lines) were already more than 400 lines. This PR adds 2 and 25 lines. A split is a separate task.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**Verdict: the code of this PR is clean. The quick gate, the light lane and clippy are green on this head. Two heavy steps are red. They are also red on bare `upstream/main` on this host, so this PR does not cause them. The head does not get `merge-ready`, because not all the steps that I ran are green.**

Re-review of head `cd3669c58`, trial-merged with `upstream/main` `1a4c69d06` (trial merge `816d2a434`). This `main` has #3786, the fix for #3774. Built and tested locally (macOS, Apple silicon). Tier: safety (the plasma clause of the post verification gate).

### Earlier findings (review of 2026-11-23 on this head)

- `app suites: rotary_verify` red (#3774, from `main`): **fixed by main**. #3786 merged. The step is green on this trial merge.
- No code finding was open. The head and the diff do not change.

### Results (local, trial merge `816d2a434`)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 307 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled |
| in it: `rotary_verify`, `mcp_plasma`, `plasma_gate`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_edge_work` | ok |
| `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main` | 6 steps, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` (62 steps reached) | 63 steps, **2 failed** |

The two red heavy steps:

1. `app heavy: flute_reach`, `a_ten_mm_flute_names_its_cause_before_the_rapid_findings` (`flute_reach.rs:102`): 12 `RapidInStock` findings, the test expects 3.
2. `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm`, `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` (`pocket3d_hsm.rs:157`): the triple is `(4688, 4660, 1980)`. This is outside the macOS band. Issue #2371 records that the macOS aarch64 triple is not measured.

I ran these two tests on bare `upstream/main` `1a4c69d06` (without this PR), in release. The two tests fail with the same values. Both are mill generation and verify tests. This PR changes only the plasma clause and the `verify` output of its warnings. The cause is in `main` or in the platform, not in this PR.

**Extra suites run:** `mcp_plasma` (5 passed), `plasma_gate`, `rotary_verify`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_edge_work`: ok. The diff changes no `testdata/` file and no importer code, so the test-data and importer suites are not necessary.

**Goldens moved:** none. The diff changes no `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file. This agrees with the body.

### Mutations (each on the trial merge, then restored; pin `plasma_mcp_verify_lists_a_tip_up_as_a_finding_and_an_operation_warning`)

1. `mcp/job.rs:359`: remove the `findings.push` of the gate warnings. Result: red at `mcp_plasma.rs:275`.
2. `posting_plasma.rs:57`: `TipUp` gets no warning kind, so the tip-up becomes a gate problem. Result: red at `mcp_plasma.rs:275`.

After the restore, `mcp_plasma` is green (5 passed).

### Requested before merge

None in the code of this PR. The label waits for green heavy results for `flute_reach` and `pocket3d_hsm`. These results come from a fix on `main` (or a measured macOS triple, #2371), or from a heavy run on the Linux cut runner.

### Notes (not blocking, from the earlier review)

- `crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs:357`: `verify` with a `name` lists the gate warnings of all plasma operations. This agrees with the gate problems, which are also for the whole program.
- `crates/app/src/posting.rs` and `crates/app/src/script/api.rs` were already more than 400 lines before this PR.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**Verdict: clean. `merge-ready`.**

Re-label pass of head `cd3669c58`. The head did not change after the two earlier reviews of this head. The rule changed on 2026-11-23: the heavy lanes are not a merge condition (AGENTS.md #3556), and a step that is also red on bare `upstream/main` does not block.

### Earlier findings

- Code findings: none were open.
- The two red heavy steps of the earlier review (`app heavy: flute_reach`, `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm`) fail the same way on bare `upstream/main` `1a4c69d06`. Under the new rule, they do not block this PR.
  - `pocket3d_hsm` on macOS aarch64: tracked by #2371.
  - `flute_reach`: tracked by #3811.

### New trial merge

`upstream/main` moved to `7f4915a6d`. It changed `crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs`, a file that this PR also changes (#3520 adds `Warning::RapidInPart`). Thus I built and tested again.

- Trial merge `9d795fe3e` (`cd3669c58` + `7f4915a6d`): the merge is clean, with an automatic merge of `job.rs`.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 308 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- In the quick gate: `mcp_plasma`, `plasma_gate`, `rotary_verify`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_edge_work` are ok.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Extra suites run:** `mcp_plasma`, `plasma_gate`, `rotary_verify`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_edge_work` (all ok). The diff changes no `testdata/` file and no importer code.

**Goldens moved:** none. This agrees with the body.

**Mutations:** not run again. The head did not change. The earlier review ran two mutations on this head, and both were red as expected.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
